method: Create chronological pre-race features for distance/surface/venue/class changes, rest, jockey and trainer changes, recent finish/speed/final-3F trends, historical market residuals, exact context records and entity interactions. Train pointwise, pairwise and ensemble market-free ranking models before every target month, force five races per venue/day, select a full-budget course policy only from earlier rolling OOS months, and reserve May-August 2026 as a final holdout.
